reason: My orders come in fast, in my own Hindi with regional words and my own item names, and I do not believe a machine will read them right. My udhaar diary is my business and I am not handing it to something I cannot check, so I stay with the diary and my son on the phone.
objection: Will it understand my Hindi, my regional words and my item names? If it gets one order or one udhaar entry wrong, I spend more time fixing it than I save, and I cannot hand my khata to a thing I do not trust.
would_change_my_mind: A person comes to my shop and shows it reading my own real voice notes and my own item names correctly, a day of my actual orders, with no mistakes. Then I would let my son try it free for the 3 months alongside the diary.
